content.text: {"id": "mm5422a3", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the completeness of reporting was estimated at 46% for laboratory reports alone and 54% for HCP reports alone"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "median reporting times were 8 days for laboratories (interquartile range [IQR]: 6--13 days) and 12 days for HCPs"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the completeness of reporting was estimated at 46% for laboratory reports alone and 54% for HCP reports alone"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "1,493 (28%) were reported only by laboratories"}]}, {"v": "continuous", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "median reporting times were 8 days for laboratories (interquartile range [IQR]: 6--13 days) and 12 days for HCPs"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Using either laboratory and/or HCP reporting, the system accounted for 75% of the estimated total number of cases"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "median reporting times were 8 days for laboratories (interquartile range [IQR]: 6--13 days) and 12 days for HCPs"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the completeness of reporting was estimated at 46% for laboratory reports alone and 54% for HCP reports alone"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "evaluation or monitoring", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "This report summarizes an evaluation of chlamydial-infection reporting in Massachusetts during January--June 2003."}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Completeness of reporting was calculated by using the Sekar-Deming capture-recapture method"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Timeliness of reporting chlamydial infection was determined by calculating the median number of days from laboratory specimen collection"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The capture-recapture method requires that the two systems being evaluated are independent"}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": ["outcome_types"]}
